title: chat-server: nested isPublic filter, senderMsgId sentinel
description:
From batch 11 review (HEAD cc87669d).
1. vwr2 follow-up: MemoryBackend Space/query reveals non-member public Spaces only when isPublic:true is at the filter top level; chat-00 33702a5 L1394 says 'when the request includes an isPublic: true filter condition', which includes one nested in a FilterOperator (e.g. AND[{isPublic:true},{name:x}]) (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs).
2. pnci follow-up: senderMsgId uses the in-band sentinel 'placeholder' (memory.rs ~L912-915); a server-originated Message (store_server_message / Peer/deliver) whose peer-supplied senderMsgId is literally 'placeholder' is rewritten to the local id, contradicting backend.rs docs. Use an out-of-band marker (Option/flag).
notes: Mark 2026-10-21: part 2 superseded by a workspace-wide sweep (separate bead): create_object takes a builder FnOnce(&Id) -> O; backend mints the id, calls the builder, stores atomically. Removes PLACEHOLDER_ID and the senderMsgId sentinel. Part 1 landed in 27374d58.
close_reason: Part 1 landed in 27374d58 (CI green at 1a26cf40, not separately reviewed); part 2 superseded by JMAP-dpbp
